title: Dataset of psychophysiological data from children with learning difficulties who strengthen reading and math skills through assistive technology
description: This dataset comprises psychometric and electroencephalographic (EEG) data collected from Mexican children with reading or math learning difficulties, aimed at evaluating the efficacy of the assistive online learning platform Smartick in improving academic skills. Data were collected from 76 subjects across two study groups (reading and math difficulties), each divided into experimental and control subgroups, with EEG and psychometric assessments performed before and after a three-month intervention period. The EEG recordings include resting-state and task-related conditions (reading comprehension or arithmetic problem solving), accompanied by psychometric measures such as reading speed, comprehension, math skills, selective attention, and IQ.
methods_description: Participants underwent two EEG sessions (pre- and post-intervention), each including a 3-minute eyes-open resting-state recording and a task-related recording. For the reading difficulties group, tasks involved reading aloud and answering comprehension questions; for the math difficulties group, tasks involved solving two blocks of 20 arithmetic operations. Psychometric assessments included spelling, reading speed, reading comprehension, math knowledge, reaction time, selective attention, and IQ tests. EEG data were stored in .set format following BIDS conventions.
